channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: Erik Karlsson Stepped Up In Crosby, Malkin's Absence; Continues To Drive Penguins Playoff Push
item.description: The Pittsburgh Penguins are having a strong season, and veteran blueliner Erik Karlsson has been one of their key contributors, exceeding expectations and contributing to Pittsburgh’s playoff push as a key offensive catalyst.

item.title: Hurricanes, Kraken To Battle In Finland For NHL Global Series
item.description: The Carolina Hurricanes and Seattle Kraken were selected to play two regular-season games in Helsinki, Finland, as part of the NHL Global Series. The arena they're scheduled to play in had been closed for three years.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Rangers Could Find A Summer Market For Vincent Trocheck
item.description: The New York Rangers could find teams more receptive to meeting their asking price for Vincent Trocheck this summer. Meanwhile, there are new rumors and speculation about some NHL goalies.

item.title: The Oilers Shouldn't Wait To Replace Kris Knoblauch With Peter DeBoer
item.description: It's rare for a Stanley Cup contender to fire its coach this late in the season. But if the struggling Edmonton Oilers decide to go that route right now, Peter DeBoer would be a terrific fit.

item.title: Who's Hot And Cold In The NHL: Kucherov And Hellebuyck's Streaks Are Mind-Boggling
item.description: Nikita Kucherov and Connor Hellebuyck's stats this past week require a double-take for opposite reasons. They're two of five NHL players whose hot or cold weeks deserved a closer look.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: What Would Happen If The NHL Playoffs Started Today?
item.description: Ryan Kennedy, Michael Traikos and Michael Augello discuss Alex Ovechkin's future, what the playoffs would look like if they started today, prospect news and much more.

item.title: Predicting NCAA's Hobey Baker Hat Trick Finalists: McKenna, Wyttenbach Highlight Top 10
item.description: Just being a top-three finalist for the Hobey Baker Award is a huge accomplishment in NCAA men's hockey. Tony Ferrari examines the top 10 to predict who will make the next cut.

item.title: The Vancouver Canucks Flip-Flopped Hard This Season. Will It Pay Off?
item.description: The Vancouver Canucks went from hoping for a bounce-back season to trading parts of their core and beginning a rebuild. Here's how they ended up being eliminated from playoff contention and what comes next.

item.title: What Top NHL Prospect Anton Frondell Brings To The Blackhawks Right Now
item.description: Chicago Blackhawks top prospect Anton Frondell is expected to make his NHL debut this week. Based on what he's shown in the Swedish League and in his career to date, he should bring a jolt of energy to the Hawks.

item.title: Bruins Top Prospect James Hagens To Join AHL Providence On ATO
item.description: James Hagens is set to join the AHL's Providence Bruins on an amateur tryout after his NCAA season ended.
